description: This file defines the DrugsByNameComparator class, which implements a comparator for Drug objects. It sorts drugs by their names while ignoring numericals and special characters, focusing only on alphabetic characters for comparison.

classes.name: DrugsByNameComparator
classes.description: A comparator for Drug objects that sorts by drug name ignoring numericals and special characters, and is serializable.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Overrides the compare method to compare two Drug objects by their processed names.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals
methods.description: Compares two drug names after removing non-letter characters, ignoring numericals and special characters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Utility method to remove all characters except a-z and A-Z from a given string.
